author: Jiaqi Zhu W2 design preparation
scope: Source review, historical simulator evidence, independent browser prototype; no engineering edits or owner acknowledgments

evidenceLevels.SOURCE_VERIFIED: Read current tracked source; not proof of runtime or cloud behavior
evidenceLevels.HISTORICAL_REPORT: Existing dated report/screenshot; not newly executed
evidenceLevels.BROWSER_PROTOTYPE: Independent HTML/CSS/JavaScript design; validation file records executed checks
evidenceLevels.PENDING_NATIVE: Current native simulator/device/user test not executed this round

p0Statement: No P0 confirmed by this bounded source/design review; not a release guarantee

issues.title: Five-type task baseline conflicts with seven-type current main and eight-item W1 proposal

evidence.observation: Seven codes including TYPHOON and CUSTOM; no HEAVY_RAIN
Deliberate latest change merges heavy rain/storm into STORMY and supports private custom names of 1-20 code points
Historical actual UI: five supported choices plus three disabled proposals
Eight-item W1 proposal with custom names of 1-10 code points plus icon/color options

issues.designAction: Use separately labeled five-type W2 browser review baseline, show extension ideas only as proposals; preserve latest engineering seven-type source
issues.closureCriteria: Actual owners record intended acceptance version and full consumer/contract plan; no silent enum rollback

issues.title: Small date navigation controls fall below the W1 44px target in source dimensions

evidence.observation: nav-btn width/height 65rpx; at 390px viewport approximately 33.8px
month-button min-height 65rpx
month-privacy month-button min-width 48rpx
At least 44x44px interaction target is the project design criterion

issues.measurementMethod: Static conversion px=rpx*viewportWidth/750; not a DevTools hitbox measurement
issues.designAction: At least 44x44px hitboxes in independent W2 prototype; keep icon visual size separate
issues.closureCriteria: Measure actual interactive nodes at target widths and with device touch; owner implements/accepts change

demo-banner font-size22rpx

Same visual selected-class pattern
